name: sdd
description: Spec-driven workflow for requirements (REQ), change requests (CR), implementation specs, and three-stage reviews; conclusions live in REQ, argumentation in reviews.

interface.shortDescription: REQ / CR / spec / review workflow with TDD implementation.
interface.longDescription: Six skills: sdd (status and next step), draft (read-only exploration), req (capture current business logic as a REQ), create-cr (change request as item-level delta), implement-cr (write spec, implement step by step with TDD, finalize REQ), review-cr (docs / spec / impl reviews with reproducible findings). Deterministic parts (numbering, scaffolding, validation, index) are handled by a stdlib-only Python script.
defaultPrompt: Use sdd:sdd to show the status of REQ / CR documents and the next step.
Use sdd:create-cr to open a change request against an existing REQ.
Use sdd:review-cr to review a change at the docs, spec, or impl stage.
